record.body:
## Description

R1: A test creates a temporary store with `canon init --schemas score,conductor,tuner,composer`.
R2: The test runs `orchestra idea` through the installed entry point and creates an open idea.
R3: The test creates an area and assigns it to the idea with the `canon` calls `triage-ideas` documents.
R4: The test runs `orchestra view roadmap` through the installed entry point and finds the idea under its area.
R5: The test creates the effort with the `canon` calls `init` documents.
R6: The test promotes the idea with the `canon` call `init` documents for the engage path.
R7: The test runs `orchestra view roadmap` again and finds the idea as promoted with its effort.
R8: `canon validate` on the temporary store reports no errors at the end.
R9: The test never reads or writes the live store.

## Approach

Create `tests/test_composer_e2e.py`. Reuse the session-scoped `installed` fixture and helpers in `tests/test_cli_packaging.py` (move shared helpers to `tests/conftest.py` only if importing them is awkward). Build one module-scoped fixture that runs the whole flow once against a temporary git repo, using the installed `canon` and `orchestra` entry points as subprocesses with cwd set to that repo and no checkout on PATH or PYTHONPATH: (1) `canon init --schemas score,conductor,tuner,composer`; (2) `orchestra idea "Show a roadmap"`; (3) the triage calls from `skills/triage-ideas/SKILL.md`: `canon create --type composer:area --subject dash --payload '{"title":"Dashboard"}' --body '## Scope\n\nThe dashboard.'`, then `canon supersede --type composer:idea` with payload `{"area":"dash"}` (read id and revision with `canon list --type composer:idea --subject show-a-roadmap --exact-subject --state active`); (4) `orchestra view roadmap`, saved; (5) the calls `init` documents to create the effort: `canon create --type score:effort` (payload `goal`, `kind`) and `canon create --type score:position` on the same subject; (6) the promote call `init` documents: `canon supersede --type composer:idea` with payload `{"status":"promoted","effort":"<effort>"}`; (7) `orchestra view roadmap` again, saved; (8) `canon validate`. Keep the commands in the test the same as the skills show; read the effort payload fields from `skills/init/SKILL.md` and the score schema. Then write one test per requirement id, named `test_r1_...` to `test_r9_...`, each asserting its own observable: R1 store created; R2 idea open with subject show-a-roadmap; R3 area assigned; R4 first roadmap lists the idea under `## dash`; R5 effort exists; R6 idea promoted with effort; R7 second roadmap shows the idea as promoted with the effort; R8 validate has no errors; R9 the live store at the repo root `.canon` is unchanged (compare a hash of the file list before and after).
record.subject: composer-e2e-test
